item.title: [ZEPPELIN-2724] Zeppelin gets stuck with java.lang.Thread.State: BLOCKED (on object monitor)
item.description:
We are using Zeppelin in 10+ active users environment. At least 2-3 times per day Zeppelin hangs with no errors in log files.

I checked Jstack and looks like Zeppelin is waiting for lock on some resource
"qtp905654280-2488" #2488 prio=5 os_prio=0 tid=0x00007fcbacfa9000 nid=0x3a00 waiting for monitor entry [0x00007fcb826a7000]
java.lang.Thread.State: BLOCKED (on object monitor)
at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookServer.removeConnectionFromAllNote(NotebookServer.java:449)

  • waiting to lock <0x000000068006d060> (a java.util.HashMap)
    at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookServer.sendHomeNote(NotebookServer.java:851)
    at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookServer.onMessage(NotebookServer.java:241)
    at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookSocket.onWebSocketText(NotebookSocket.java:59)

which is locked by other thread.

at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookSocket.send(NotebookSocket.java:72)

  • locked <0x000000079e7d7b88> (a org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookSocket)
    at org.apache.zeppelin.socket.NotebookServer.broadcast(NotebookServer.java:495)
  • locked <0x000000068006d060> (a java.util.HashMap)
